newsitem.headline: Weekly U.S. forward contract slaughter cattle.

text.p: Forward Contract Slaughter Cattle Summary week ending December 12, 1996

Volume includes both contract and formula priced cattle committed for delivery in a specified month. Prices shown are for contracted cattle based on current or next Chicago Mercantile Exchange delivery month. Price levels for other cattle are determined later by various formulas or arrangements.
